notes.title: Endings guide now on Steam - thanks for the support of The Final Prize is Soup!
notes.notes:
It's been only a few days since the launch of [i]The Final Prize is Soup[/i], and we're super grateful for the support from all of you! Over 2000 accounts have redeemed this game on Steam.

We'd also like to highlight the community guide that a Steam player made - we appreciate the hard work and it'll help out fellow players a lot:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3319663001

Once again, thank you, everyone that's played and/or left a review! If you've played, please consider leaving a review, it helps us a lot to bring more yuri games to Steam!

notes.title: The Final Prize is Soup - out now on Steam
notes.notes:
Excited to share that the game is out now! If you played, please support us by leaving a review, so we can bring more titles like this to you on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2903060/The_Final_Prize_is_Soup/

Features include:

[list]
[*]~45k word main story
[*]2 main heroines (2 major endings / 6 dead ends)
[*]Cinematographic storytelling
[*]Accessibility options
[*]A CG gallery, a music gallery, dev notes, and an achieved endings screen
[*]Steam achievements
[*]Original music tracks
[*]New dev Q&A
[*]King route side story
[/list]
